subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should every agent-scoped caller without explicit active-sandbox context fail closed for all sandbox media, including files belonging to its own session?
rationale: This is an intentional security-versus-compatibility contract: source inspection supports the isolation fix, but only the media-access owner can confirm whether deliver, Control UI, finalization, and plugin-facing paths are expected never to consume direct sandbox paths.

options.title: Confirm fail-closed contract
options.body: Require direct caller-level proof, then retain the rule that only callers carrying an exact active sandbox workspace may access sandbox media.

options.title: Propagate more sandbox context
options.body: Identify legitimate non-message callers and thread their canonical active workspace through the same exact-root contract before merging.

options.title: Pause for boundary redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until the owning-session sandbox capability can be represented without changing existing caller behavior.

recommendation.title: Confirm fail-closed contract
recommendation.body: Require direct caller-level proof, then retain the rule that only callers carrying an exact active sandbox workspace may access sandbox media.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged history ties this person most directly to the current agent-scoped media-root and outbound-access design.
